definitions.en: to build or put parts together

example.en: Engineers construct a bridge from many smaller parts.
example.zh: 工程师用许多小部件建造一座桥。

learning.coreIdea: 把部件放到一起形成结构。
learning.watchOut: construct 强调建造；constitute 强调构成。

definitions.en: to damage or destroy a structure

example.en: The device is designed to self-destruct.
example.zh: 这个装置被设计为自毁。

learning.memoryHook: de 把 struct 拆下来。
learning.watchOut: destruct 较正式或技术化；destroy 更常用。

definitions.en: to carry people or goods from one place to another

example.en: Trains transport passengers across the city.
example.zh: 火车把乘客运送穿过城市。

learning.watchOut: transport 偏运输；transfer 偏转移位置或权限。

definitions.en: to bring goods or data into a place or system

example.en: The company imports coffee from Brazil.
example.zh: 这家公司从巴西进口咖啡。

learning.watchOut: import 和 important 形近但词源路径不同。

definitions.en: to send goods or data out of a place or system

example.en: The app can export your notes as a PDF.
example.zh: 这个应用可以把笔记导出为 PDF。

learning.watchOut: export 是输出；exploit 是利用或剥削。

definitions.en: kind and wishing to do good

example.en: The fund was created by a benevolent donor.
example.zh: 这项基金由一位仁慈的捐赠者创立。

learning.watchOut: benevolent 是态度仁慈；beneficial 是结果有益。

definitions.en: having or showing a wish to harm others

example.en: The rumor had a malevolent purpose.
example.zh: 这个谣言带有恶意目的。

learning.watchOut: malevolent 强调意图；malignant 常用于恶性或有害性质。

definitions.en: a person who gives help, especially money

example.en: The school thanked its benefactor publicly.
example.zh: 学校公开感谢了它的捐助者。

morphemes.note: agent suffix placeholder until suffix catalog is expanded

learning.watchOut: benefactor 给帮助；beneficiary 接受好处。

definitions.en: to make goods, often in large quantities

example.en: The factory manufactures medical equipment.
example.zh: 这家工厂制造医疗设备。

learning.coreIdea: 从手工制作引申为工业制造。
learning.watchOut: manufacture 强调生产过程；produce 更宽泛。

definitions.en: an object made by humans, often of historical interest

example.en: The museum displayed an ancient artifact.
example.zh: 博物馆展出了一件古代文物。

learning.watchOut: artifact 是人工制品；article 是文章或物品。

definitions.en: to say words for someone to write down or to command

example.en: The policy will dictate how data is stored.
example.zh: 这项政策将决定数据如何存储。

learning.watchOut: dictate 是命令/口述；dedicate 是奉献。

definitions.en: to say what will happen before it happens

example.en: The model predicts tomorrow's demand.
example.zh: 这个模型预测明天的需求。

learning.watchOut: predict 是预测；predicate 是语法谓语或断言。

definitions.en: to say the opposite of something or be inconsistent with it

example.en: The second report contradicts the first.
example.zh: 第二份报告与第一份报告矛盾。

learning.watchOut: contradict 是矛盾/反驳；contrast 是对比。

definitions.en: an impressive public sight or display

example.en: The parade was a colorful spectacle.
example.zh: 游行是一场色彩斑斓的壮观景象。

learning.watchOut: spectacle 可指场面；spectacles 可指眼镜。

definitions.en: to look at something carefully

example.en: The technician inspected the engine.
example.zh: 技术员检查了发动机。

learning.watchOut: inspect 是检查；expect 是期待。

definitions.en: to regard someone or something with care or honor

example.en: Good teams respect different opinions.
example.zh: 好的团队尊重不同意见。

learning.watchOut: respectful 是恭敬的；respective 是各自的。

definitions.en: able to be seen

example.en: The mountain is visible from the window.
example.zh: 从窗户可以看见那座山。

morphemes.note: suffix placeholder until suffix catalog is expanded

learning.memoryHook: vis + ible = able to be seen。
learning.watchOut: visible 是可见；visual 是视觉的。

definitions.en: to review and change or study again

example.en: She revised the essay after feedback.
example.zh: 她根据反馈修订了文章。

learning.watchOut: revise 常含修改；review 可只是回顾。

definitions.en: to force something or someone out

example.en: The pilot ejected from the aircraft.
example.zh: 飞行员从飞机中弹射出来。

learning.watchOut: eject 可指弹出；evict 常指依法驱逐。

definitions.en: to put something into something else, often by force

example.en: The nurse injected the medicine carefully.
example.zh: 护士小心地注射了药物。

learning.watchOut: inject 常带压力或进入内部；insert 是插入。

definitions.en: a planned task, or to throw forward, display, or estimate

example.en: The team will project sales for next year.
example.zh: 团队将预测明年的销售额。

learning.coreIdea: 把东西向前抛出，引申为计划或投影。
learning.watchOut: project 作名词重音通常在前；作动词重音通常在后。

definitions.en: to send information, signals, or disease from one place to another

example.en: Satellites transmit signals around the world.
example.zh: 卫星向全球传输信号。

learning.watchOut: transmit 强调发送信号/疾病；transfer 强调转移。

definitions.en: to send away or refuse to consider

example.en: The judge dismissed the case.
example.zh: 法官驳回了这个案件。

morphemes.note: dis prefix to be split into its own root in a later schema pass

learning.watchOut: dismiss 不是 miss 的简单加强，而是 send away。

definitions.en: to allow, or an official document allowing something

example.en: The city issued a parking permit.
example.zh: 市政府签发了一张停车许可证。

learning.watchOut: permit 作名词和动词重音可能不同。

definitions.en: to sign up for or agree with an idea

example.en: Many readers subscribe to the newsletter.
example.zh: 许多读者订阅这份通讯。

learning.coreIdea: 在下面签名，后来变成订阅或赞同。
learning.watchOut: subscribe to 可表示订阅，也可表示赞同观点。

definitions.en: to say or write what something is like

example.en: Can you describe the route?
example.zh: 你能描述一下路线吗？

learning.watchOut: describe 用语言描述；depict 用图像或文字描绘。

definitions.en: words written or carved on something

example.en: The ring has a short inscription inside.
example.zh: 戒指内侧有一段短题词。

learning.coreIdea: 写或刻在某物上的文字。
learning.watchOut: inscription 是铭文；subscription 是订阅。

definitions.en: to change something into another form

example.en: The tool converts speech into text.
example.zh: 这个工具把语音转换成文字。

learning.watchOut: convert 是转换；convey 是传达或运输。

definitions.en: to return to a previous state

example.en: The system reverted to its old settings.
example.zh: 系统恢复到了旧设置。

learning.watchOut: revert to 后接旧状态；reply 是回复消息。

definitions.en: to prevent something bad or turn away

example.en: Quick action averted a crisis.
example.zh: 迅速行动避免了一场危机。

morphemes.note: historical form from ab/ad group; to refine later

learning.watchOut: avert 常接危机/危险；avoid 更普通。

definitions.en: to continue or move forward

example.en: After the check, we can proceed.
example.zh: 检查之后，我们可以继续进行。

learning.watchOut: proceed 是继续；precede 是在前。

definitions.en: to be greater than a limit or expectation

example.en: Demand exceeded supply.
example.zh: 需求超过了供应。

learning.watchOut: exceed 是超过；excel 是擅长。

definitions.en: to achieve success or come after someone

example.en: She succeeded through steady practice.
example.zh: 她通过稳定练习取得了成功。

learning.coreIdea: 跟着走到结果，后来表示成功或接替。
learning.watchOut: succeed in doing something；不要直接说 succeed to do。

definitions.en: to move back or become more distant

example.en: The floodwater began to recede.
example.zh: 洪水开始退去。

learning.watchOut: recede 是退去；reseed 是重新播种。

definitions.en: to lead, organize, or carry out

example.en: Researchers conducted a survey.
example.zh: 研究人员开展了一项调查。

learning.watchOut: conduct 作名词可指行为，作动词可指实施。

definitions.en: to formally bring someone into a role or group

example.en: The club inducted three new members.
example.zh: 俱乐部吸纳了三名新成员。

learning.watchOut: induct 是引入/就任；deduct 是扣除。

definitions.en: to make or bring something forth

example.en: The process produces less waste.
example.zh: 这个过程产生更少废料。

learning.watchOut: produce 作名词可指农产品，重音不同。

definitions.en: to make something smaller or less

example.en: Walking can reduce stress.
example.zh: 散步可以降低压力。

learning.watchOut: reduce 是减少；deduce 是推论。

definitions.en: able to be heard

example.en: Her voice was barely audible.
example.zh: 她的声音几乎听不见。

morphemes.note: suffix placeholder until suffix catalog is expanded

learning.memoryHook: aud + ible = able to be heard。
learning.watchOut: audible 是听得见；edible 是可食用。

definitions.en: the people who listen to or watch something

example.en: The speaker knew her audience well.
example.zh: 演讲者很了解她的听众。

learning.coreIdea: 正在听的人群，后来包括观众和受众。
learning.watchOut: audience 是受众；audition 是试镜/试听。

definitions.en: related to speech sounds

example.en: The dictionary includes phonetic symbols.
example.zh: 这本词典包含音标。

learning.watchOut: phonetic 偏语音学；phonics 偏自然拼读教学。

definitions.en: a long musical work for orchestra, or a harmonious combination

example.en: The orchestra performed a new symphony.
example.zh: 管弦乐队演奏了一首新交响曲。

learning.watchOut: symphony 是交响；sympathy 是共感。

definitions.en: a person's own signature

example.en: Fans waited for the actor's autograph.
example.zh: 粉丝等待演员的亲笔签名。

morphemes.note: auto root to be added if pilot expands self-family words

learning.watchOut: autograph 是签名；autobiography 是自传。

definitions.en: a written account of someone's life

example.en: The biography covers her early career.
example.zh: 这本传记讲述了她早期的职业生涯。

learning.coreIdea: 把一个人的生命经历写下来。
learning.watchOut: biography 是别人写的人生；autobiography 是自传。

definitions.en: the study of populations and their structure

example.en: Demography helps planners understand population change.
example.zh: 人口统计学帮助规划者理解人口变化。

learning.watchOut: demography 是人口研究；democracy 是民主制度。

definitions.en: an instrument for viewing very small objects

example.en: Students observed cells through a microscope.
example.zh: 学生通过显微镜观察细胞。

morphemes.note: scope root can be split later if more scope words are added

learning.memoryHook: micro + scope = look at small things。
learning.watchOut: microscope 看小物；microphone 收声音。

definitions.en: an instrument for viewing distant objects

example.en: The telescope revealed distant galaxies.
example.zh: 望远镜揭示了遥远的星系。

morphemes.note: scope root can be split later if more scope words are added

learning.watchOut: telescope 是望远镜；telegraph 是远距离书写/电报。

definitions.en: the order of events in time

example.en: The report gives a clear chronology of events.
example.zh: 报告给出了清晰的事件时间顺序。

learning.watchOut: chronology 是时间顺序；chronicle 是编年记录。

definitions.en: to make things happen at the same time

example.en: The app synchronizes data across devices.
example.zh: 这个应用在多台设备之间同步数据。

learning.watchOut: synchronize 是同步；synergize 是协同增效。

definitions.en: to subtract or take away from a total

example.en: The fee will be deducted from your account.
example.zh: 这笔费用将从你的账户中扣除。

learning.watchOut: deduct 是扣除；deduce 是推论。
